data.review_body:
I would advise anyone using Aliexpress to only order one item at a time because with multiple items in a package Aliexpress assumes all items are present and will not refund any missing items as happened to me with one missing item. Aliexpress guarantees are worthless and they will ensure they take up so much of your time and make it impossible to satisfy what they ask for that in the end you give up as your time is more valuable than the missing item. Here is the list of actions they insist on to consider a refund, as can be seen most of which is impossible to achieve, and of course it's designed that way!
To better handle your complaint regarding quality issues, please provide the following evidence to assist us in determining the actual situation:
1. Postal service proof/logistics documentation confirming abnormalities with the package. The document must include the following details:
·Package tracking number: The tracking number should match the one provided by the seller.
·Logistics status: The content on the document must reflect the issue you encountered, such as descriptions of missing items, damage, etc.
·Issuer of the document: The email address should originate from the logistics company. For offline documents (such as photos or PDF files), they must come from the corresponding logistics companyâ€”for example, bearing the official seal or signature of the logistics company.
2. A complete unboxing video showing that the problem existed upon receipt of the item. The video must include:
·The package label clearly visible.
·A full view of the intact, unopened package.
·If there are two layers of labels, the bottom label underneath must be shown after removing the top layer.
·The recording time.
·A detailed and clear recording of the specific issue, ensuring smooth playback without lagging, frame dropping, or editing.
3. Communication records with the seller (e.g., admissions of error, promises of refunds, etc.) as this serves as supplementary evidence. If provided, it will enable a clearer determination of the seller's issues.
Good luck to anyone trying to comply with that lot!!

And to add insult to injury you get invited to complete a survey on the way in which they've handled your request  .... BUT! ..... you can't complete the survey because it's all in Chinese!
Yep, you guessed it, it's designed that way so that their customer service staff never get any negative feedback! (Clever eh!).

data.review_body:
Appalling crooks!

I ordered a spare battery for my Insta 360 X4. It arrived in a few days. The box was marked Insta 360 X4, the battery was well make, but it is too large for the Insta 360 X4 Camera. I asked for a refund, they asked for image of the damage, there was not any. I sent photographs proving the box was marked Insta 360 X4, the camera is Insta 360 X4 and this battery would not fit this camera ever. After lots of applications I recieved a notice stating, "After careful review, we regret to inform you that your recent return/refund request did not meet our evidence standards and, therefore, we are unable to process your refund. To maintain fairness and integrity on our platform, we kindly suggest that you refer to our 【User Evidence Guidelines】 to further specify the issues with the product. We are committed to assisting you and will address your concerns promptly. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation!" . I will never use these devious shits ever again, and cannot say avoid hard enough ever.

I ordered multiple items; 12 arrived defective or not matching their
listings - seller fault, not change of mind. AliExpress approved every
dispute and refunded the product cost.

The catch: the return process forced 12 separate return shipments to a
single destination, so I paid for 12 individual labels myself - $78.51
out of pocket. Before shipping, I asked support twice whether return
shipping would be reimbursed. On two separate chats, agents confirmed
in writing that it would be. I have both screenshots.

I shipped all 12 parcels relying on those written promises. AliExpress
then refunded the products but refused the $78.51 return shipping, and
never once addressed the commitments their own agents made. Email
support declined; a live-chat agent only offered to "document" it.

If your agents give written assurances, honour them. I'm asking for the
$78.51 your team promised - nothing more than what was already committed
to me in writing.

data.review_body:
Misleading product advertisements, slow shipping and unwillingness to refund purchases. 

I ordered a DIY felt patchwork kit from QQH Store via AliExpress.

The product was totally different than advertised.
Different colour material, no pattern template and no embellishments (eyes, flowers, etc.).                         Only embroidery threads, stuffing, material and a cheap scissor.
A refund was requested, but due to insufficient proof ( photos of the delivered order was provided to show the differences and the absence of certain items) that the product was different than advertised, the refund was refused. See below:

Request complete
Final Solution
No refund
Based on the insufficient proof you provided, we cannot approve this request. You can contact Customer Service for more help.
Request information
Pink Woodland Friends DIY Felt Patchwork Kit
Qty:1
36-Blush Fox diy patchwork set 
R222.85
Reason: Inaccurate website description
Submission time: PST 2026-07-24 03:09:16
Order ID: 3074489362621153

A dissatisfied customer have no rights and can apparently not return and be refunded for a product that does not correspond with a website advertisement and does not meet a customer’s expectations.
Goodbye Aliexpress, I will not shop from you again!
